g.text: Prompt: Design a 28 GHz 8x8 phased array and evaluate the 500 m comms link
8x8 Taylor-tapered array at 28 GHz: peak gain 23.1 dB, 12.6 deg beamwidth,
sidelobes -13.2 dB. The 500 m comms link at 200 MHz bandwidth closes with 22.8 dB
SNR margin. Audit log, provenance manifest, and OpenTelemetry trace are in the run
